note: Adapted from Emerson's 1925 species-level redescription (in English), which states explicitly that it is a renaming and redescription of Nasutitermes holmgreni Banks (1918, p. 667, soldier), so this entry rests on Emerson's description, not on Banks's original; the description covers the soldier and alate, type locality Tukeit, British Guiana. The figures for total soldier length, pronotum width and hind tibia are damaged in the scanned text and are not listed.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: This name is the new name proposed by Emerson for the British Guianan N. holmgreni described by Banks (1918), since von Rosen had already used Eutermes Holmgreni for an African species in 1912. Soldier head dark reddish brown, darkest at the base of the nasus, the lateral outline convex, not elevated at the base, antennae 11—12-segmented; alate antennae 13—14-segmented, eyes large and prominent.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head brownish black, oval, covered with hairs and a few long bristles; fontanelle indistinct. Antennae 13—14-segmented; with 13, segment 3 longer than segment 2 and segment 2 equal to segment 4; with 14, segment 3 very short, segment 4 shorter than segment 2 and segment 2 equal to segment 5. Eyes large, prominent, rather close to the lower margin of the head; ocelli large, about 1/4 of their width from the eyes. Labrum paler than the head; postclypeus paler than the head, median line indistinct. Pronotum brown, much paler than the head, posterior margin concave. Posterior margins of the meso- and metanota broadly concave. Legs brown, paler than the pronotum. Wings rather dark, smoky. Abdominal tergites brown, the middle of the sternites pale. Measurements: length with wings 10.50—11.00 mm; length without wings 5.50—6.50 mm; head length 1.09—1.16 mm; head width 0.96—1.03 mm; antennal length 1.28—1.45 mm; eye diameter 0.82 mm; pronotum length 0.42—0.45 mm; pronotum width 0.71—0.80 mm; hind tibia length 1.00 mm; fore wing length 8.69—8.75 mm; fore wing width 2.36—2.48 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head dark reddish brown, darkest at the base of the nasus; lateral outline convex, the base of the nasus not elevated. Vertex covered with short hairs, with a few longer bristles at the base of the nasus and on the vertex. Antennae pale yellow, 11—12-segmented; with 11, segment 3 much longer than segments 2 and 4, segment 2 slightly longer than segment 4; with 12, segment 3 very short, segment 4 equal to segment 5, segment 2 slightly longer than segment 4. Tip of the nasus slightly paler than the rest of the head, of medium length, the surface with scattered microscopic hairs. Thorax brown; anterior margin of the pronotum dark brown, not concave. Legs brownish yellow. Abdominal tergites brown, paler than the head; sternites pale yellow; tergites covered with microscopic hairs, the posterior margin with a row of long bristles. Measurements: head length 1.06—1.26 mm; antennal length 0.96—1.12 mm; pronotum length 0.67—0.74 mm.
